note: site_audit_send (submodule of site_audit, depends on site_audit_report_entity) delivers saved audit reports to a remote endpoint on demand or on cron. Config object site_audit_send.settings: remote_url, remote_label, cron_save_interval, cron_send_interval, cron_delete_interval (seconds; 0 = never). It has NO settings route of its own - these fields are injected into the main Site Audit settings form (/admin/reports/site-audit/settings) via hook_form_site_audit_config_form_alter(). Service site_audit_send.rest_client (RestClient::postReport/testUrl). Send methods via hook_site_audit_send_send_methods() (report_api, email). Event site_audit_report_sent. Medium cases read a known config value; hard cases write remote_url / a cron interval, verified against live config.

evals.prompt: What does the site_audit_send submodule do, and where do you configure the remote server it sends audit reports to?
evals.expected_output: It delivers saved Site Audit reports to a remote endpoint (e.g. a Site Audit Server) on demand or on cron. It has no settings page of its own; its Remote Server URL and cron intervals are added into the main Site Audit settings form at /admin/reports/site-audit/settings, and stored in config site_audit_send.settings.

evals.prompt: Which configuration keys does site_audit_send use for scheduling recurring audits and for the remote endpoint, and what config object holds them?
evals.expected_output: Config object site_audit_send.settings holds remote_url, remote_label, and three cron intervals (in seconds, 0 = never): cron_save_interval, cron_send_interval, cron_delete_interval.

evals.prompt: Which service and method does site_audit_send use to POST a saved report to the remote server from code?
evals.expected_output: The site_audit_send.rest_client service (Drupal\site_audit_send\RestClient); call postReport($report_entity) to POST the report's fields as JSON to the configured remote_url (testUrl($url) validates an endpoint).

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has site_audit_send configured to send reports to a remote server. Inspect the live configuration and report the remote server URL.
On this site, site_audit_send is configured to send audit reports on a recurring cron schedule. Inspect the live configuration and report the send interval (in seconds).
On this Drupal site, configure site_audit_send to send audit reports to the remote endpoint https://sas-task.example.com/api/site-audit . Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set site_audit_send.settings remote_url to https://sas-task.example.com/api/site-audit (via the Remote Settings on the Site Audit settings form, or config). Verify checks the config value exactly.

evals.prompt: I want my site to automatically save a site audit report once every hour using the site_audit_send module. Set that up on the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set site_audit_send.settings cron_save_interval to 3600 (the 'Save report every' = 1 hour option on the Site Audit settings form, or config). Verify checks cron_save_interval === 3600.
